authority_boundary: Tool config affects tool behavior only. Missing or invalid config blocks only the tool command that needs it.

proof_command_contract.id_rule: Use stable ids that Evidence Packets and receipts can cite.
proof_command_contract.execution_boundary: Configured commands do not authorize execution outside the active Work Boundary.

manual_fallback: When config is absent, record exact proof commands directly in the Evidence Packet and run methodology checks manually.
